Three source forms are now on record as tried against this (nested-ternary retained, explicit-else, load-then-conditional-overwrite) - the axis is at its cap and was NOT re-probed. (b) 1 of 7 is the lone target-only blt at T@458c, and it is a REDUNDANT branch: target emits `cmpwi r0,88` / `beq ->4594` / `blt ->46b4` / `b ->46b4` where BOTH non-equal paths reach the same address, so behavior is identical and this is not a semantic defect. Two prior records (attempt.audioenternextstage-portable-branch-pair-closure.20260831.v2, attempt.init-enemy-vars-reconstruction.20260831.v1) already document this same coalescing defeating the same lever in other functions, so no probe was spent. attributes.semantic_finding: A SPURIOUS (f32) CAST WAS COMPARING AT THE WRONG PRECISION. src/game/game/pmotion.c:1355 read `if (sMusicFadeBase > (f32)(lbl_80347B88 + p->combo_fade))`. Target authority at the aligned diff shows NO rounding: 0x10d4 `lfd f1,@lbl_80347B88` / 0x10d8 `lfs f0,2300(r31)` / 0x10dc `lfs f2,@sMusicFadeBase` / 0x10e0 `fadd f0,f1,f0` / 0x10e4 `fcmpo cr0,f2,f0` - the comparison is made against the UNROUNDED f64 sum, whereas ours inserted `frsp f0,f0` before the fcmpo. The site is identified unambiguously by its guard, target `cmpwi r30,137` matching the source's `else if (anim == 137)`. The TU's own sibling site at pmotion.c:1171 already spells the same expression the target's way, `(f64)sMusicFadeBase < lbl_80347B88 + p->combo_fade`, so the cast at 1355 was a local inconsistency, not the TU's convention. Fixed to match the sibling; the extra frsp is gone (ours-only -2 frsp -> -1 frsp).
